commit_binding: implementation_commit is the tested Round 3 code commit. This review request and test_summary are added in the subsequent evidence commit. The short review reference COMMIT must identify the PR branch head containing these evidence files; compare it exactly with the GitHub branch head.
goal: Add NFC normalization before case-fold identity derivation, stable JSON serialization, and independent-process determinism while preserving the accepted Round 1 and Round 2 behavior.

tests.cross_process_check: Two subprocesses used PYTHONHASHSEED values 1 and 999 with opposite insertion orders; serialized stdout matched exactly.

questions: Verify that NFC normalization is applied to the trimmed display value before canonical identity derivation.
Verify that composed and decomposed equivalents collapse to one logical identity and store an NFC display value.
Verify that serialization is deterministic and canonical for repeated calls, equivalent Unicode values, and reversed insertion orders.
Verify that the cross-process test launches separate interpreters with different hash seeds and compares exact serialized stdout.
Check that no Round 1 or Round 2 behavior regressed, and give any smallest evidence-based correction needed.
